historical_result.preceding_snapshot_error: Step 3 returned a destroyed-execution-context snapshot error despite tool-wrapper success.

diagnostic_contract.action_scope: frozen actions 1-3, then read-only target geometry at 0, 2 and 5 seconds; no merge-request creation

reviewed_cause.mechanism_zh: 原轨迹第 3 步快照报错，第 4 步的 New merge request 链接点击超时。只读对照显示，同一选择器在两个版本的 DOM 中都匹配多个链接；页面加载完成后，官方 1.1.6 的这些链接仍全部为零面积，固定候选则有一个非零面积的可见入口。因此旧版超时不能只归咎于快照报错或等待不足，符合动态列表更新后旧布局快照未刷新的故障家族。
reviewed_cause.mechanism_en: The original step-3 snapshot errored and the step-4 New merge request click timed out. The read-only comparison found multiple DOM links matching the same selector in both builds. After page load completed, all such links still had zero-area rectangles in official 1.1.6, while one fixed-candidate link had nonzero visible geometry. The old timeout cannot be attributed solely to the snapshot error or insufficient waiting; it is consistent with stale layout after dynamic list updates.

scope_limit: This is a same-page 1.1.6-versus-fixed geometry probe on the current Rainbond site, not a rerun of formal Moli 1.1.3, a commit-level bisect, or proof that merge-request creation persisted in the original trajectory. The historical official score is unchanged.
